source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 3 exercise solved (PDF 89-93): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short, long and inquisitive questions, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Diagram wale sawalon (short Q14, Q15) mein tasveer lafzon mein bayan ki gayi hai. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Which one of the following eukaryotic cell structures does not contain DNA?
(Eukaryotic cell ka kaun sa hissa DNA nahi rakhta?)

options.text: Nucleus
Mitochondrion
Endoplasmic reticulum
Chloroplast

blocks.explanation: Nucleus mein cell ka DNA hai, aur mitochondria aur chloroplasts ka apna gol DNA hai; endoplasmic reticulum mein DNA nahi (3.4).

blocks.prompt:
2. Which of the following is not an accurate description of a chromosome?
(Chromosome ki kaun si tafseel durust nahi?)

options.text: Yeh nucleus mein rang pakarne wala jism (coloured body) hai
Yeh protein aur nucleic acid ka majmooa hai
Yeh cell ka woh hissa hai jis mein genetic material hai
Eukaryotes mein yeh kai DNA molecules se bana hai jo sire se sira jure hain

blocks.explanation: Har chromosome mein ek hi lamba DNA molecule (histone proteins ke saath) hota hai; insaan ka DNA 46 molecules mein bata hai, har chromosome ke liye ek (3.4). Is liye (d) ghalat hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. A centriole is an organelle that is:
(Centriole aisa organelle hai jo:)

options.text: Cell ke cytoplasm ke beech mein hota hai
Microtubules ka bana hai aur spindle fibres ko tarteeb dene mein aham hai
Membrane se ghira hota hai
Chromosome ka hissa hai

blocks.explanation: Centriole microtubules ke nau triplets ka khokhla cylinder hai, membrane ke baghair; yeh spindle fibres samet microtubules ko tarteeb deta hai (3.4).

blocks.prompt:
4. The rough endoplasmic reticulum is:
(Rough endoplasmic reticulum kya hai?)

options.text: Cell ke andar membranes ka nizam jis par ribosomes jure hote hain
Cell ke andar membrane jis par microtubules jaisi cheezein jari hon
Mitochondria ke andar membrane ka hissa
Sirf prokaryotic cells mein milta hai

blocks.explanation: RER endoplasmic reticulum ka woh hissa hai jis ki satah par ribosomes lage hote hain (3.4); yeh eukaryotic cells mein hota hai, prokaryotes mein nahi. Sirf option (a) is ko bayan karta hai, magar is ka lafz 'double-membrane' durust nahi: ER ki sirf aik membrane (single membrane) hoti hai (Kitab ki ghalti dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Options (b), (c) aur (d) ke label do dafa chhape hain: "(b) b)", "(c) c)", "(d) d)". Izafi "b)", "c)", "d)" chhapai ki ghalti hain, option ka hissa nahi. Option (a) mein bhi ghalti hai: ER single membrane (aik jhilli) wala nizam hai, yani membrane ki thailiyon aur nalkiyon (cisternae) ka jaal; double membrane sirf nucleus, mitochondria aur chloroplast ke gird hoti hai. Sahi bayan: "an intracellular membrane system to which ribosomes are attached". (b) ghalat (RER par ribosomes hote hain, microtubules nahi), (c) ghalat (ER cytoplasm mein hai, mitochondria ke andar nahi), (d) ghalat (prokaryotes mein ER hota hi nahi). (a) is liye jawab rakha gaya ke 'double' ke lafz ke ilawa yahi sahi bayan hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. In the nucleus of eukaryotic cells, the genetic material is complexed with protein and organized into linear structures called:
(Eukaryotic cells ke nucleus mein genetic material protein ke saath mil kar seedhi (linear) sakhton mein munazzam hota hai jinhein kehte hain:)

options.text: Centrioles
Histones
Chromosomes
Plasmids

blocks.explanation: Chromatin (DNA aur histone proteins) simat kar chromosomes banta hai (3.4). Histones khud proteins hain; plasmids bacteria ka gol DNA hain.

blocks.prompt:
6. Which of the following statements does not apply to the nuclear envelope?
(Kaun sa bayan nuclear envelope par lagu nahi hota?)

options.text: Yeh double membrane hai
Yeh endoplasmic reticulum se mili hui hai
Is mein pores hain jin se cheezein aati jati hain
Is ke andar ki taraf mude hisse cristae banate hain

blocks.explanation: Cristae mitochondria ki andar wali membrane ke mude hisse hain, nuclear envelope ke nahi. Nuclear envelope pores wali double membrane hai jo ER se juri hai (3.4).

blocks.prompt:
7. Lysosomes are formed by budding from which cellular organelle?
(Lysosomes kis organelle se kali (bud) ki tarah nikal kar bante hain?)

options.text: Smooth endoplasmic reticulum
Golgi apparatus
Rough endoplasmic reticulum
Nucleus

blocks.explanation: Lysosome ke enzymes ER mein bante aur Golgi apparatus mein tabdeel hote hain; Golgi ki kuch products pak kar lysosomes ban jati hain jo us se alag hoti hain (3.4).

blocks.prompt:
8. All peroxisomes carry out this function:
(Tamam peroxisomes yeh kaam karte hain:)

options.text: Fats aur amino acids ko chhote molecules mein torna jo mitochondria energy ke liye istemal karein
Hydrolytic enzymes se bare molecules hazam karna
Membrane ke hisse, jaise fatty acids aur phospholipids, banana
Cell mein ions ke aane jane ko control karna

blocks.explanation: Peroxisomes mein oxidative enzymes hote hain; un ka aam kaam fatty acids (aur kuch amino acids) ko oxidize kar ke chhote molecules banana hai jo mitochondria mein jate hain (chapter se aage; chapter oxidation aur zehr khatam karne ka zikr karta hai). Hydrolytic hazma (b) lysosomes ka kaam hai; ions ka control (d) plasma membrane ka.

blocks.prompt:
9. How would the absence of peroxisomes in a cell affect its metabolism, and what would be the likely symptoms?
(Agar cell mein peroxisomes na hon to metabolism par kya asar hoga aur mumkina alamaat kya hongi?)

options.text: Cell oxidative phosphorylation nahi kar sakega aur ATP kam banega.
Cell mein hydrogen peroxide jama hoga, oxidative stress aur cell ko nuqsaan hoga.
Protein synthesis kharab hogi aur muscles kamzor hongi.
Cell lipids nahi bana sakega aur membrane kamzor hogi

blocks.explanation: Peroxisomes mein catalase hota hai jo hydrogen peroxide (metabolism ka zehreela by-product) ko pani aur oxygen mein torta hai (3.4). In ke baghair H2O2 jama ho kar cell ko nuqsaan deta hai; maslan Zellweger syndrome.

blocks.prompt:
10. Which of the following does not apply to chloroplasts?
(Kaun si baat chloroplasts par lagu nahi hoti?)

options.text: In mein chlorophyll aur photosynthesis ke enzymes hote hain.
In ke andar thylakoids ka membrane nizam hota hai.
Yeh ATP banate hain.
Yeh do membranes se ghire hain, jin mein andar wali cristae mein mudi hoti hai.

blocks.explanation: Chloroplasts ki do membranes hain magar andar wali cristae mein nahi mudti; cristae mitochondria mein hoti hain. Chloroplasts mein thylakoids aur grana hote hain aur roshni mein ATP banta hai (3.4).

blocks.prompt:
11. What is the correct sequence of membrane compartments through which a secretory protein moves from synthesis to release from the cell?
(Secretory protein banne se cell se bahar nikalne tak kin membrane hisson se kis tarteeb mein guzarta hai?)

options.text: SER → Golgi apparatus → RER → Cell membrane
Cell membrane → Golgi apparatus → RER → SER
RER → Golgi → Cell membrane → SER
RER → SER → Golgi apparatus → Cell membrane

blocks.explanation: Secretory protein RER ke ribosomes par banta hai, vesicles mein Golgi ke cis face tak jata hai, wahan tayyar hota hai aur trans face se secretory vesicles mein cell membrane tak ja kar exocytosis se bahar nikalta hai (3.4). Sirf (d) RER se shuru aur cell membrane par khatam hota hai, Golgi us se pehle.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Chhapi hui koi tarteeb bilkul durust nahi. Chapter ke mutabiq raasta: RER → (vesicles) → Golgi apparatus → (secretory vesicles) → cell membrane; SER is ka baqaida hissa nahi. (a) SER se shuru hota hai aur RER ko Golgi ke baad rakhta hai, (b) cell membrane se ulta chalta hai, aur (c) protein ke cell se nikal jane ke baad SER par khatam hota hai. Murad jawab (d) rakha gaya: sirf is mein RER pehle aur Golgi cell membrane se theek pehle hai; sirf is ka izafi SER wala qadam ghalat hai.

blocks.prompt:
12. How does the process of facilitated diffusion differ from active transport?
(Facilitated diffusion active transport se kaise mukhtalif hai?)

options.text: Facilitated diffusion ko energy chahiye, active transport ko nahi
Facilitated diffusion ko energy nahi chahiye, active transport ko chahiye
Dono ko energy chahiye
Dono ko energy nahi chahiye

blocks.explanation: Facilitated diffusion passive hai (transport proteins ke zariye zyada se kam concentration ki taraf); active transport energy (ATP) laga kar kam se zyada concentration ki taraf le jata hai (3.7).

blocks.prompt:
1. Compare the resolution and magnification of light microscope and electron microscope?
Light microscope aur electron microscope ki resolution aur magnification ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Electron microscope ki magnification aur resolution light microscope se kahin zyada hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. State the cell theory. How we can validate it? What are the exceptions to cell theory?
Cell theory bayan karein. Ise kaise saabit kiya ja sakta hai? Is ke istisna (exceptions) kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
Cell theory: (1) tamam jandar ek ya zyada cells se bane hain; (2) cell banawat aur kaam ki bunyadi ikaai hai; (3) cell sirf pehle se maujood cells se bante hain.
Saboot: light aur electron microscopy, live-cell imaging aur genetic studies, DNA sequencing, cell culture.
Istisna: viruses, prions aur viroids (cell nahi); apna DNA rakhne wale mitochondria aur chloroplasts; kai nuclei wale fungi, algae aur muscle fibres.

blocks.prompt:
3. The table below compares the process of diffusion, facilitated diffusion and active transport. Fill in the blank cells , using the words “YES” or “NO”.
(Rows printed: Is ATP required? / Are carrier proteins involved? / Is direction of transport always from higher to lower concentration?)
Neeche table mein diffusion, facilitated diffusion aur active transport ka muqabla hai. Khali khanon mein "YES" ya "NO" likhein.
blocks.explanation: Sirf active transport ATP leta hai aur gradient ke khilaf chalta hai; facilitated diffusion aur active transport dono carrier proteins istemal karte hain.

rows: Kya rukh hamesha zyada se kam concentration ki taraf?

blocks.prompt:
4. Categorize the organelles as (i) single membrane bounded, (ii) double membrane bounded and (iii) lacking any membrane.
Organelles ko (i) ek membrane wale, (ii) do membrane wale aur (iii) baghair membrane ke mein taqseem karein.
blocks.explanation:
(i) Ek membrane: endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, lysosomes, peroxisomes, glyoxysomes, vacuoles.
(ii) Do membranes: nucleus (nuclear envelope), mitochondria, chloroplasts.
(iii) Koi membrane nahi: ribosomes, centrioles, cytoskeleton (aur nucleolus).

blocks.prompt:
5. State two functions of the proteins in the plasma membrane.
Plasma membrane ke proteins ke do kaam bataein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Transport: yeh channels ya carriers ban kar cheezon ko membrane ke paar chun kar le jate hain.
2. Receptors: yeh messenger molecules (maslan hormones) se jur kar signal cell ke andar bhejte hain.
(Mazeed: cytoskeleton se jorna, glycoprotein ban kar pehchan ke nishan, enzymes.)

blocks.prompt:
6. State two features that mitochondria have in common with prokaryotes.
Mitochondria ki do khususiyaat bataein jo prokaryotes se milti hain.
blocks.explanation:
1. In ka apna gol (circular) DNA hai, prokaryotes ke DNA jaisa.
2. In mein 70S ribosomes hain, prokaryotes jaise.
(Yeh cell se alag khud taqseem bhi hote hain, jo nigle gaye prokaryotes se in ke banne ki daleel hai.)

blocks.prompt:
7. List three ways in which prokaryotic cells differ from eukaryotic cells.
Teen tareeqe likhein jin mein prokaryotic cells eukaryotic cells se mukhtalif hain.
blocks.explanation: Prokaryotic cells mein asal nucleus aur membrane wale organelles nahi, ribosomes chhote aur taqseem binary fission se.

rows: Asal nucleus nahi; DNA nucleoid mein
Membrane wale organelles nahi (mitochondria, ER, Golgi nahi)

blocks.prompt:
8. List the structures and molecules, which can cross the nuclear envelope.
Woh sakhtein aur molecules likhein jo nuclear envelope paar kar sakte hain.
blocks.explanation: Nuclear pores ke zariye: nucleus ke andar chhote molecules, DNA aur RNA ke building blocks (nucleotides), ATP aur kuch bare proteins jaise histones; nucleus se bahar nucleolus mein bane ribosomal subunits (aur mRNA, chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
9. Distinguish each of the following pairs.
a- exocytosis and endocytosis
In joron mein farq bataein. a- exocytosis aur endocytosis
blocks.explanation: Dono bari cheezon ko vesicles mein membrane ke paar le jate hain, magar ulti simt mein.

rows: Vesicle plasma membrane se mil jata hai
Plasma membrane andar dhans kar vesicle banati hai

blocks.prompt:
9. b- phagocytosis and pinocytosis
b- phagocytosis aur pinocytosis
blocks.explanation: Dono endocytosis ki qismein hain.

rows: Cell thos cheezein andar leta hai
Cell maaye (liquid) qatron ki shakal mein leta hai

blocks.prompt:
9. c- peroxisome and glyoxysomes
c- peroxisome aur glyoxysomes
blocks.explanation: Dono ek membrane wale enzyme bhare organelles hain; glyoxysomes plants ki khaas qisam hain.

rows: Sirf plant cells mein (charbi wale beej)
Oxidative enzymes aur catalase; zehr khatam aur H2O2 torna
Enzymes lipids ko carbohydrates mein badalte hain
Misal: jigar ke cells alcohol ka zehr khatam karte hain
Misal: ugte hue castor bean beej

blocks.prompt:
10. What are the main functions of lysosomes?]
Lysosomes ke bare kaam kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Lysosomes hazme ke khane hain jin mein taqreeban 40 hydrolytic enzymes hain. Yeh phagocytosis se aayi cheezein (white blood cells mein bacteria, viruses) hazam karte hain, purane cell hisson (autophagy) aur bare molecules ko dobara istemal ke liye torte hain, aur nashonuma mein poore cells khatam karte hain (maslan tadpole ki dum).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal ke aakhir mein faltu bracket chhapa hai: "lysosomes?]". "]" chhapai ki ghalti hai.

blocks.prompt:
11. Describe the role of the Golgi body in forming lysosomes.
Lysosomes banane mein Golgi body ka kirdar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Lysosome ke hydrolytic enzymes RER par bante hain aur vesicles mein Golgi body ke cis face tak jate hain. Golgi inhein tabdeel kar ke pack karta hai, aur yeh trans face se membrane wale vesicles mein alag hote hain jo pak kar lysosomes ban jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
12. What are histones? Where are these found in eukaryotic cells?
Histones kya hain? Eukaryotic cells mein yeh kahan paye jate hain?
blocks.explanation: Histones chhote proteins hain jin ke gird DNA lipat kar nucleosomes (chromatin ke moti) banata hai. Yeh nucleus mein chromatin aur chromosomes mein hote hain (bacteria ke DNA mein histones nahi).

blocks.prompt:
13. What do you mean by “stem cell”? What are the main usages of stem cells?
"Stem cell" se kya murad hai? Stem cells ke bare istemal kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
Stem cells ghair-makhsoos (unspecialized) cells hain jo apni nayi copies bhi banate hain aur kai qisam ke cells (muscle, khoon, dimagh) mein badal sakte hain.
Istemal: regenerative medicine (tissues ki marammat, maslan spinal cord injury, type 1 diabetes, Parkinson's, dil ki bimari), dawaiyon ki testing aur bimari ke models, aur mareez ke apne cells se personalized ilaaj.

blocks.prompt:
14. The following diagram shows the structure of a mitochondrion. Name structures A to G.
(Diagram: a mitochondrion cut open lengthwise. A points to a thread-like strand in the inner fluid; B to small dots in the inner fluid; C to the inner fluid-filled space; D to the inner membrane; E to the smooth outer covering; F to a knob-like particle on a crista, shown enlarged in a circle; G to the folds of the inner membrane.)
Diagram mein mitochondrion ki banawat hai. A se G tak hisson ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
A: mitochondrial DNA (gol)
B: ribosomes (70S)
C: matrix
D: inner membrane (andar wali jhilli)
E: outer membrane (bahar wali jhilli)
F: F1 particle (ATP synthase)
G: cristae

blocks.prompt:
15. The diagram below shows an electron micrograph of a cell.
a- Label the parts of the cell.
(Diagram: an animal cell with a large central nucleus containing two dark nucleoli; many parallel rough ER membranes around the nucleus; a Golgi stack with many small vesicles near the top; several mitochondria; small dark round bodies; ten blank label boxes with lines.)
Diagram mein ek cell ki electron micrograph hai. a- Cell ke hisson ke labels lagayein.
blocks.explanation:
Labels (chhapi hui tasveer ki lakeeron ke mutabiq):
Oopar: Golgi apparatus.
Bayen, oopar se neeche: secretory vesicles (Golgi vesicles); nuclear pore / nuclear envelope; mitochondrion; nuclear envelope; nucleus (chromatin, nucleolus samet); lysosome.
Dayen, oopar se neeche: mitochondrion; rough endoplasmic reticulum; azad ribosomes plasma membrane ke qareeb.
Agar poocha jaye: nucleolus (nucleus mein gehra dhabba), plasma membrane, cytoplasm.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Micrograph mein pehchan ka tareeqa: beech mein bara gol = nucleus, us mein gehre dhabbe = nucleolus; nucleus ke gird bohat si mutawazi (parallel) lakeerein jin par daane hon = rough ER; chapti thailiyon ka dher jis ke kinare gol bulbule hon = Golgi aur vesicles; lambi gol cheez jis ke andar lakeerein hon = mitochondrion; chhota gehra gol = lysosome.

blocks.prompt:
15. b- What evidence can be seen in the diagram that suggests that the cell is metabolically active and involved in secretion of enzymes?
b- Diagram mein kya saboot hai ke cell metabolically active hai aur enzymes ka ikhraj (secretion) karta hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Bohat sa rough ER ribosomes ke saath: protein (enzyme) zyada ban rahe hain.
2. Bara Golgi apparatus aur bohat se vesicles: secretions ki tayyari, packing aur bahar bhejna.
3. Kai mitochondria: banane aur nikalne ke liye zyada ATP.
4. Bara nucleus aur numayan nucleoli: bohat se ribosomes ban rahe hain.

blocks.prompt:
1. Write details of the structure and the chemical composition of cell walls of eukaryotes and prokaryotes.
Eukaryotes aur prokaryotes ki cell walls ki banawat aur kimiyai tarkeeb tafseel se likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Cell wall cell ke gird kam o besh thos teh hai jo bacteria, fungi, plants aur algae mein hoti hai; ise hatane par baqi cell protoplast kehlata hai.
Plant cell wall (eukaryote):
1. Middle lamella: sab se pehle cytokinesis ke cell plate se banti hai; magnesium aur calcium pectates ki jelly jaisi teh jo parosi cells ki primary walls ko jorti hai.
2. Primary wall: middle lamella ke andar banti hai; cellulose, hemicellulose aur pectin ki, cellulose microfibrils har zawiye par hydrogen bonds se jure; proteins bhi.
3. Secondary wall: kuch cells mein pakne ke baad protoplast aur primary wall ke darmiyan; lignin, cellulose aur hemicellulose; lignin ise zyada sakht banata hai.
4. Plasmodesmata: deewaron ke aar paar naliyan jo parosi cells ke cytoplasm jorti hain.
Doosre eukaryotes: algae mein cellulose aur glycoproteins (diatoms mein silica); fungi mein chitin.
Prokaryotes: bacteria aur cyanobacteria ki wall peptidoglycan (murein) ki, jo sugars (glycan chains) aur amino acids (peptide jor) ka ek bara polymer hai, lipids ke saath; Gram-positive mein moti, Gram-negative mein patli aur us par lipopolysaccharide-lipoprotein ki outer membrane. Archaea ki wall doosre polysaccharides aur proteins ki, peptidoglycan nahi.
Kaam: sakhti aur sahara, shakal aur barhne ka rukh, pani se phatne se bachana, jaraseem se hifazat, carbohydrate ka zakheera.

rows: Plants: cellulose, hemicellulose, pectin; secondary wall mein lignin
Fungi: chitin; algae: cellulose aur glycoproteins
Archaea: polysaccharides aur proteins, peptidoglycan nahi
Tehein: middle lamella, primary wall, secondary wall
Gram-negative: patla peptidoglycan aur outer membrane

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain the chemical composition and the functions of plasma membrane.
Plasma membrane ki kimiyai tarkeeb aur kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Kimiyai tarkeeb (fluid mosaic model, Singer aur Nicolson, 1972):
1. Lipids: phospholipids ki do tehein (bilayer); pani pasand (hydrophilic) phosphate sir bahar ki taraf aur pani se door (hydrophobic) dumein andar ki taraf. Eukaryotes mein cholesterol bilayer mein phansa hota hai jo thand mein membrane ko patla (fluid) rakhta hai.
2. Proteins: integral proteins bilayer mein tairte hain aur peripheral proteins satah se chipke hote hain (maslan red blood cell membrane: 49% protein, 43% lipid, 8% carbohydrate).
3. Carbohydrates: bahar ki satah par sugar ki chhoti chains jo proteins (glycoproteins) aur lipids (glycolipids) se juri hain; mil kar glycocalyx.
Kaam:
1. Cell ke ajza ko samet kar rakhne wali had.
2. Chun kar guzarna (selective permeability): O2, CO2, pani aasani se; sugars aur amino acids control ke saath; ghiza andar, fuzla bahar.
3. Transport proteins channels aur carriers ka kaam (active transport, maslan sodium-potassium pump).
4. Receptor proteins hormones se jur kar signal andar bhejte hain.
5. Glycoproteins aur glycolipids cell ki pehchan ke nishan (immune pehchan, tissues banna).
6. Cytoskeleton aur bahar ke fibres se jorna; kuch proteins enzymes.
7. Bari cheezon ka endocytosis aur exocytosis.

blocks.prompt:
3. Identify the role of glycolipids and glycoproteins as the cell surface markers.
Glycolipids aur glycoproteins ka cell surface markers ke tor par kirdar bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Plasma membrane ki bahar ki satah par sugar ki chains proteins aur lipids se juri hain: sugar wala protein glycoprotein aur sugar wala lipid glycolipid; dono mil kar glycocalyx.
Markers ke tor par:
1. Yeh species se species, ek species ke afraad mein, aur ek hi jism ke mukhtalif cells mein mukhtalif hote hain, is liye har cell ke apne pehchan ke nishan hain.
2. Doosre cells in nishanon ko pehchante hain; cells mein farq pehchanna zindagi ke liye zaroori hai.
3. Embryo mein cells aik doosre ke markers pehchan kar tissues aur organs mein tarteeb pate hain.
4. Immune system ke cells apne ('self') markers pehchante hain aur mukhtalif markers wale ghair cells (maslan bacteria) ko radd karte hain (transplant wala tissue bhi, chapter se aage).
5. Red blood cells par blood group antigens aise hi markers hain (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
4. Explain the structure, chemical composition and function of ribosomes.
Ribosomes ki banawat, kimiyai tarkeeb aur kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Banawat: ribosomes chhote daane jaise organelles hain, membrane ke baghair, baqi organelles se bohat chhote. Har ek ke do subunits: chhota aur bara. Eukaryotic ribosomes 80S (40S + 60S); prokaryotic, aur mitochondria aur chloroplasts ke ribosomes 70S (30S + 50S). Svedberg values jama nahi hoti kyun ke sedimentation size aur shakal par munhasir hai.
Jagah: eukaryotes mein zyada tar RER se jure, kuch cytoplasm mein azad; prokaryotes mein sab azad. Cell mein hazaron se lakhon tak, protein banane wale cells (pancreas, dimagh) mein zyada.
Kimiyai tarkeeb: taqreeban 60% ribosomal RNA (rRNA) aur 40% protein.
Banna: nucleolus mein ribosomal proteins rRNA se mil kar do subunits banate hain jo nuclear pores se nikal kar cytoplasm mein sirf protein banate waqt jurte hain.
Kaam: protein synthesis. mRNA DNA se hidayat lata hai, tRNA amino acids lata hai, aur ribosome inhein jor kar polypeptide chain banata aur chhor deta hai. Azad ribosomes cell ke apne liye, RER wale bahar bhejne ke liye proteins banate hain.

blocks.prompt:
5. Explain the structure, and functions of Golgi complex.
Golgi complex ki banawat aur kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Camillo Golgi ne 1898 mein daryaft kiya.
Banawat: paanch se aath pyale jaisi, membrane wali chapti thailiyon (cisternae) ka dher (kuch flagellates mein 60 tak). Animal cells mein das se bees Golgi stacks, aam tor par nucleus ke qareeb. Har stack ke do rukh: cis face ER ki taraf aur trans face plasma membrane ki taraf. Gird bohat se chhote vesicles.
Kaam:
1. Cell ka taqseem aur shipping ka shoba: ER mein bane proteins aur lipids vesicles mein cis face par leta hai.
2. Unhein tabdeel karta hai: Golgi ke enzymes inhein glycoproteins aur glycolipids banate hain.
3. Trans face par products ko vesicles mein pack kar ke cell ke andar ya bahar bhejta hai; bahar jane wali cheezein secretions (exocytosis).
4. Lysosomes banata hai; kuch cheezein ER ko wapas.
5. Plant cells mein cell wall ke liye pectin aur doosre polysaccharides banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Describe the structure, chemical composition and function of chromosome.
Chromosome ki banawat, kimiyai tarkeeb aur kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Kimiyai tarkeeb: chromosomes chromatin se bane hain, yani DNA aur proteins (zyada tar histones); har chromosome mein ek lamba DNA molecule (insaan ka taqreeban 6 feet DNA 46 molecules mein bata hai, har chromosome ke liye ek).
Banawat:
1. DNA histones ke guchhon ke gird lipat kar moti jaise nucleosomes banata hai; yahi chromatin fibre hai.
2. Interphase mein chromatin dhaagon ke uljhe guchhe ki tarah phaila hota hai; taqseem ke waqt simat kar chromosomes ban jata hai.
3. Chromosome ke do baazu (chromatids) beech ke nuqte centromere par jure hote hain.
4. Euchromatin genetically active (RNA banata hai); heterochromatin inactive.
5. Kuch jagahen (nucleolus organizer regions) nucleolus banati hain.
Tadaad: har species ki apni, maslan insaan ke diploid cells mein 46, kuch cheontiyon aur roundworms mein 2, fern Ophioglossum mein 1,260; tadaad pecheedgi par munhasir nahi.
Kaam: chromosomes mein wirasati maadda (genes) hai jo cell ke kaam control karta hai, aur taqseem ke waqt genetic maloomat theek theek bachcha cells tak pohanchate hain.

blocks.prompt:
7. Discuss nuclear envelope and nuclear pore complex in detail.
Nuclear envelope aur nuclear pore complex ko tafseel se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Nuclear envelope:
1. Double membrane jo cell cycle ke zyada hisse mein nucleus ke ajza ko gher kar rakhti hai.
2. Do membranes ke darmiyan perinuclear space hai jo rough ER ke lumen se jura hai; is tarah ER aur nuclear envelope ek hi khana bante hain aur maloomat ka len den aasan hota hai.
3. Andar ki taraf protein ki teh nuclear lamina hai jo chromatin ko pakar kar sahara deti hai.
4. Cell division mein toot jati hai aur bachcha cells mein dobara banti hai.
5. Is mein chhote surakh (nuclear pores) hain jo nucleus aur cytoplasm ke darmiyan molecules ki aamad o raft control karte hain.
Nuclear pore complex: har pore ek pecheeda sakht hai jis ke kai subunits hain:
- annular subunit (pore ke andar ke gird),
- column subunit (complex ki deewar),
- ring subunit (column ke bahar ki taraf),
- lumenal subunit (complex ko envelope mein jamaye rakhta hai).
Complex se bareek fibrils nikal kar nucleus ki taraf tokri (basket) jaisi shakal banate hain.
Aamad o raft: chhote molecules guzarte hain; DNA aur RNA ke building blocks, ATP aur kuch bare proteins (histones) andar; nucleolus mein bane ribosomal subunits bahar.

blocks.prompt:
8. Explain how Golgi apparatus is involved in making cell secretions.
Golgi apparatus cell ki secretions banane mein kaise shamil hai, bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Bahar bhejne wale proteins RER ke ribosomes par bante hain; RER un mein sugars jor kar tayyar karta hai.
2. Proteins, carbohydrates, phospholipids waghera wale chhote vesicles ER se alag ho kar Golgi ke cis face tak jate hain.
3. Vesicles Golgi se mil kar apna maal us mein daal dete hain.
4. Cis se trans face tak cisternae se guzarte hue Golgi ke enzymes inhein tabdeel karte hain (maslan glycoproteins aur glycolipids banana) aur chhaant'te hain.
5. Trans face par tayyar maal secretory vesicles mein pack ho kar alag hota hai.
6. Vesicles plasma membrane tak ja kar us se milte hain aur exocytosis se maal bahar chhor dete hain. Yahi secretions hain (maslan hazme ke enzymes, hormones, mucus).
Isi liye secretion karne wale cells (maslan pancreas ke cells) mein Golgi bara hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. Describe the structure and functions of smooth and rough endoplasmic reticulum.
Smooth aur rough endoplasmic reticulum ki banawat aur kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Endoplasmic reticulum (ER): cytoplasm mein phaila chapti thailiyon aur shakhdar naliyon (cisternae) ka jaal. Tamam cisternae jure hain aur ek bara lumen (cisternal space, cell ke hajm ka 10% se zyada) banate hain jo nuclear envelope se bhi jura hai; yun ER nucleus aur cytoplasm ke darmiyan pipeline hai. Yeh bohat se compounds banata, tayyar karta aur pohanchata hai. Do qismein:
Rough ER (RER):
- Banawat: satah par ribosomes, is liye khurdari; zyada tar chapti thailiyan.
- Kaam: proteins banana aur tayyar karna; proteins mein sugars jorna; inhein zaroorat ki jagah ya Golgi tak bhejna; bahar bhejne wale proteins aur lysosome ke enzymes banana.
Smooth ER (SER):
- Banawat: ribosomes nahi, is liye hamwaar; zyada tar naliyan; aam tor par RER se kam.
- Kaam: lipids banana; carbohydrate metabolism; dawaiyon aur zehr ko be-asar karna (jigar); calcium jama karna aur calcium metabolism; muscle cells mein calcium chhor kar contraction shuru karna. Dimagh aur muscle cells (lipid aur carbohydrate metabolism) aur jigar (zehr khatam karna) mein zyada.

rows: Lipids banana; zehr khatam karna; calcium zakheera
Protein nikalne wale cells mein zyada
Jigar, dimagh aur muscle cells mein zyada

blocks.prompt:
10. Explain the role of lysosomes and peroxisomes in regulating the amounts of cellular contents.
Cell ke ajza ki miqdaar control karne mein lysosomes aur peroxisomes ka kirdar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Lysosomes (ek membrane wale hazme ke khane, taqreeban 40 hydrolytic enzymes, pH taqreeban 4.8 par active):
1. Autophagy: umr poori kar chuke ya bekaar cell hisson, aur zaid fats, carbohydrates, proteins aur bare molecules ko saada compounds mein torte hain jo cytoplasm mein wapas ja kar naye maadde banate hain. Is se organelles aur molecules ki miqdaar tawazun mein rehti hai.
2. Phagocytosis se aayi cheezein hazam karte hain (white blood cells mein bacteria, viruses).
3. Nashonuma mein poore cells khatam karte hain (tadpole ki dum, dimagh ke cells).
Agar koi enzyme na ho to cheezein jama ho jati hain (lysosomal storage diseases): Pompe's disease mein glycogen, Tay-Sachs mein dimagh ke cells mein lipids.
Peroxisomes (ek membrane wale, oxidative enzymes):
1. Zehreele maadde oxidize kar ke khatam karte hain, maslan jigar mein alcohol.
2. Catalase hydrogen peroxide (metabolism ka zehreela by-product) ko pani aur oxygen mein torta hai taake jama na ho.
3. Fatty acids torte hain (chapter se aage).
Peroxisomes ki kharabi (Zellweger syndrome) sangeen metabolic bimariyan deti hai.
Yani lysosomes bare molecules aur organelles ki miqdaar aur peroxisomes zehreele maddon ki miqdaar control karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
11. Describe the structures of the three fibres that make the cytoskeleton.
Cytoskeleton banane wale teen fibres ki banawat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Cytoskeleton cytoplasm mein protein fibres ka jaal hai:
1. Microfilaments: globular protein actin ki thos salakhein; tamam eukaryotic cells mein. Yeh tootti aur dobara banti hain, cell ki shakal badalne aur chalne, taqseem hote cell ko do mein kaatne aur myosin ke saath sukurne mein madad deti hain.
2. Microtubules: seedhe, khokhle cylinders jo subunits se bane hain, har subunit do proteins alpha-tubulin aur beta-tubulin ka. Yeh cell ko shakal dete, organelles ki aamad o raft ki sarak bante, cilia aur flagella (9+2) aur centrioles banate aur cell division mein spindle fibres banate hain.
3. Intermediate filaments: rassi jaise fibres jo mukhtalif proteins ke bane hain, aam tor par vimentin (jild ke cells mein keratin); sirf kuch aala janwaron mein. In ki motai baqi do ke darmiyan hai (chapter se aage). Yeh cell ki shakal aur sakhti qaim rakhte aur nucleus samet organelles ko jamaye rakhte hain.

blocks.prompt:
12. Describe the formation and functions of lysosomes.
Lysosomes ke banne aur un ke kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Lysosomes Christian de Duve ne daryaft kiye. Yeh gol, ek membrane wale organelles hain jin mein taqreeban 40 hydrolytic (hazme ke) enzymes hain jo tezabi mahol (pH taqreeban 4.8) mein kaam karte hain.
Banna:
1. Hydrolytic enzymes RER ke ribosomes par bante hain.
2. Vesicles mein Golgi apparatus ke cis face tak ja kar tabdeel hote hain.
3. Trans face par membrane wale vesicles mein pack ho kar alag hote hain aur pak kar lysosomes ban jate hain.
Kaam:
1. Cell ke andar hazma: lysosome phagocytosis se bane food vacuole se mil kar us ka maal hazam karta hai, maslan white blood cells bacteria aur viruses hazam karte hain.
2. Autophagy: purane organelles aur bekaar molecules torna; hasil cheezein cytoplasm mein dobara istemal hoti hain.
3. Nashonuma mein poore cells khatam karna, maslan tadpole ki dum aur dimagh ke kuch cells.
Cell mehfooz rehta hai kyun ke membrane enzymes ko band rakhti hai aur phatne par enzymes neutral cytosol mein be-asar ho jate hain. Enzyme na ho to storage bimariyan (Pompe's, Tay-Sachs).

blocks.prompt:
13. Compare mitochondria and chloroplasts as the organelles that are involved in cellular energetics.
Mitochondria aur chloroplasts ka cell ki energy ke organelles ke tor par muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Mushabehat: dono cell ke liye energy badalte hain; dono do membranes aur intermembrane space wale; dono ka apna gol DNA, RNA aur 70S ribosomes, aur dono cell se alag barhte aur taqseem hote hain (endosymbiosis ki daleel); dono ATP banate hain. Farq table mein hain.

rows: Plants aur algae mein (photosynthesis wale cells)
Oxygen se sugars aur fats tor kar ATP
Roshni pakar kar CO2 aur pani se glucose
Andar wali membrane cristae mein mudi, F1 particles (ATP synthase)
Andar membranes se thylakoids, grana ke dher, lamellae se jure
Andar maaye: stroma (CO2 fix karne wale enzymes)
Thylakoids mein chlorophyll a aur b
Oxygen lete, CO2 aur pani dete
CO2 aur pani lete, oxygen dete

blocks.prompt:
14. Describe the basic structure of a mitochondrion, from outside inward.
Mitochondrion ki bunyadi banawat bahar se andar ki taraf bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Mitochondria salakh jaise organelles hain, cell ke power house, itne bare ke light microscope se dikh jate hain. Bahar se andar:
1. Outer membrane: hamwaar; chhalni ki tarah bohat bare molecules ko rokti hai.
2. Intermembrane space: do membranes ke darmiyan tang jagah.
3. Inner membrane: bohat mudi hui, is ke andar ki taraf mude hisse cristae kehlate hain jo satah barhate hain. Is mein electron transport chain ke carriers hain.
4. F1 particles: cristae ki andar ki satah par matrix ki taraf ghundi jaise ubhaar; yeh ATP synthase enzyme hain.
5. Matrix: andar wali membrane ke neeche bari jagah; is mein respiration ke kuch marahil (Krebs cycle) ke enzymes, apna gol DNA, har qisam ka RNA aur 70S ribosomes.
Diagram: hamwaar bahar wali lakeer ka oval, andar doosri lakeer jo ungliyon jaisi cristae mein mudi ho, cristae par chhoti ghundiyan, aur matrix mein DNA ka chhalla aur ribosomes ke nuqte; paanchon hisson ke labels.

blocks.prompt:
15. Describe the pathway of protein signal and steroid signal from outside of a cell to inside.
Protein signal aur steroid signal ka cell ke bahar se andar tak raasta bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Cell signalling ke teen qadam: reception (ligand apne khaas receptor se jurta hai), transduction (signal aage barhta aur taqatwar hota hai) aur response.
Protein/peptide signalling:
1. Protein ya peptide signal pani mein hal hone wale hain, is liye plasma membrane se nahi guzar sakte.
2. Ligand plasma membrane par apne khaas receptor protein se jurta hai.
3. Jurne se receptor ki shakal badalti hai (conformational change) aur woh active ho jata hai.
4. Active receptor cell ke andar reactions ka silsila (cascade) shuru karta hai jo second messengers jaise cyclic AMP (cAMP) banata hai; calcium ions aur IP3 bhi second messengers hain.
5. Second messengers response late hain: genes ka on/off, metabolism, enzymes, cell ka barhna, taqseem ya apoptosis.
Steroid signalling:
1. Steroid hormones lipid mein hal hone wale (lipophilic) hain, is liye seedha plasma membrane se guzar jate hain.
2. Andar cytoplasm ya nucleus mein khaas receptors se jurte hain.
3. Active receptor-hormone complex ban kar nucleus mein jata hai (agar pehle wahan na ho).
4. Nucleus mein complex target genes ke khaas DNA sequences se jurta hai.
5. Is se transcription control hoti hai aur khaas proteins zyada ya kam bante hain.
Bara farq: protein signal bahar ke receptor aur second messengers se; steroid signal andar ke receptor se seedha genes par.

rows: Pani mein hal; membrane paar nahi
Lipid mein hal; membrane se guzar jata hai
Hormone-receptor complex seedha DNA se jurta hai
Metabolism, enzymes ya genes mein tabdeeli

blocks.prompt:
16. Categorize and explain different types of stem cells.
Stem cells ki mukhtalif qismein taqseem kar ke bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Stem cells kai qisam ke cells ban sakte hain; taqseem par har naya cell stem cell reh sakta hai ya makhsoos cell ban sakta hai.
A. Salahiyat (potency) ke lehaz se:
1. Totipotent: har mumkin qisam ka cell, maslan zygote aur us ki pehli chand taqseemon ke cells.
2. Pluripotent: taqreeban har cell, maslan ibtidai embryo ke cells.
3. Multipotent: qareeb ke rishtedar cells ka khandan, maslan hematopoietic stem cells se red cells, white cells aur platelets.
4. Oligopotent: chand qisam ke cells, maslan adult lymphoid ya myeloid stem cells.
5. Unipotent: sirf apni qisam ka ek cell, magar apni nayi copies bana sakte hain, maslan adult muscle stem cells.
B. Maakhaz (origin) ke lehaz se:
1. Embryonic stem cells (ESCs): blastocyst ke inner cell mass se; pluripotent, bohat kaam ke; masail: insaani embryo ka istemal, teratoma ka khatra, immune rejection.
2. Adult stem cells (ASCs): bone marrow, charbi, khoon mein; multipotent; akhlaqi tanaza kam aur rejection ka khatra kam (apna tissue), magar salahiyat mehdood aur alag karna mushkil.
3. Induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs): lab mein adult somatic cells ko khaas transcription factors se dobara programme kar ke; ESCs ki tarah pluripotent.

blocks.prompt:
17. What are the advantages and disadvantages of using induced Pluripotent Stem Cells?
Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells ke istemal ke faide aur nuqsanat kya hain?
blocks.explanation: iPSCs lab mein adult somatic cells ko khaas transcription factors se pluripotent halat mein dobara programme kar ke banaye jate hain.

rows: ESCs wala akhlaqi masla nahi: embryo khatam nahi hota
Reprogramming se genetic tabdeeliyan aa sakti hain
Mareez ke apne cells se: immune rejection kam
Transplant ke baad rasoli (teratoma) ban sakti hai
Pluripotent: kharab tissues (dil ke cells, neurons) dobara bana sakte hain
Inhein khaas, poori tarah kaam karne wale cells banana mushkil
Bimari ke models aur dawa ki testing ke liye mufeed
Yeh yaqeeni banana mushkil ke cells theek kaam karein

blocks.prompt:
1. If a researcher observes that a certain cell type has an exceptionally large Golgi apparatus, what can be inferred about the function of this cell?
Agar kisi cell mein Golgi apparatus ghair maamooli bara ho to us cell ke kaam ke bare mein kya nateeja nikalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Golgi apparatus cell ki products tabdeel, pack aur bahar bhejta hai. Bohat bara Golgi batata hai ke cell secretory hai jo bari miqdaar mein proteins aur glycoproteins bana kar bahar bhejta hai, maslan enzymes, hormones ya mucus (jaise pancreas ke cells ya goblet cells); plant mein yeh cell wall ke liye pectin jaise polysaccharides bana raha ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. If a signalling molecule is lipid-soluble, like a steroid hormone, what is the most likely mechanism for its action within the target cell?
Agar signal molecule steroid hormone ki tarah lipid mein hal hone wala ho to target cell mein us ke amal ka sab se mumkin tareeqa kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Lipid mein hal hone ki wajah se yeh seedha plasma membrane ki phospholipid bilayer se guzar jata hai. Andar cytoplasm ya nucleus mein khaas receptor se jurta hai; hormone-receptor complex nucleus mein ja kar target genes ke khaas DNA sequences se jurta hai aur un ki transcription on ya off karta hai, is tarah khaas proteins zyada ya kam bante hain. Membrane receptor ya second messenger ki zaroorat nahi.

blocks.prompt:
3. Why do we categorize endocytosis and exocytosis in active transport?
Endocytosis aur exocytosis ko active transport mein kyun shumar kiya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke in mein cell ko energy (ATP) kharch karni parti hai. Bari cheezein membrane se diffuse nahi ho saktin; cell ko membrane andar morni, vesicle bana kar alag karna, use cytoplasm mein (cytoskeleton ke saath) chalana aur membrane se milana parta hai. In harkaton aur membrane ki tabdeeliyon mein ATP lagta hai, aur maadda concentration gradient ki parwah kiye baghair le jaya jata hai, is liye yeh active hain, passive nahi.

blocks.prompt:
4. Justify why the membrane may be described as fluid.
Saabit karein ke membrane ko fluid (behne wali) kyun kaha ja sakta hai.
blocks.explanation:
Fluid mosaic model ke mutabiq membrane sakht nahi:
1. Phospholipid molecules jame hue nahi; har teh mein dayen bayen harkat karte hain, is liye bilayer maaye (liquid) ki patli teh jaisi hai.
2. Proteins lipid bilayer mein tairte aur hil sakte hain (fluid lipid samandar mein proteins ka 'mosaic').
3. Phospholipids ke darmiyan cholesterol thand mein bhi membrane ko fluid rakhta hai.
4. Membrane mur sakti, mil sakti, endocytosis aur exocytosis mein vesicles bana sakti aur khud jur jati hai.
5. FRAP (fluorescence recovery after photobleaching) mein bleach kiya hua hissa dobara chamak jata hai kyun ke doosre lipids aur proteins wahan aa jate hain; yeh un ki harkat ka saboot hai.
